---
title: "Untether 0.36.1 — Antigravity CLI joins, with approvals, questions and plans in Telegram"
---

## TL;DR
You can now run Google's Antigravity CLI from Telegram, with the same approval buttons, questions, steering and Plan first card Claude Code users already have. Group chats, webhooks and error messages are also safer. Please read **Heads up** before you upgrade.

## ✨ What's new for you
- **Antigravity CLI engine.** Pick it with `/agent set antigravity` or `/antigravity <prompt>` (needs `agy` 1.3.1 or newer). Choose how much it may do in `/config` → Permission mode: **Workspace** (the safe default: edits files in the project, no shell), **Plan first**, **Ask me** (approval and question buttons in Telegram) or **Full access**. It resumes with `/continue`, compacts with `/compact` and lists background work as it runs. Built on a contribution from [@manuelnaranjo](https://github.com/manuelnaranjo), thank you! ([#558](https://github.com/littlebearapps/untether/issues/558))
- **Loops tell you when they stop.** A Claude loop that reaches its cap now posts a short note instead of going quiet.
- **No more duplicate uploads.** Sending the same file twice no longer saves `_1`, `_2` copies.

## 🛠️ Fixes you'll notice
- Quick follow-ups run in the order you sent them, and no longer start a second conversation while the first is starting.
- `/cancel` works while a run is still starting.
- A failed `/continue` or an old resume line no longer clears the chat's saved session.
- Telegram hiccups (a `502`, a dropped connection) no longer leave a stuck "working" card or spam the logs.
- Lists, bold links and `.webp` images from agents display properly.
- `/config` explains Diff preview accurately for each permission mode.
- A bad cron schedule is caught when the config loads, and one broken trigger no longer switches off the rest.

## 🧹 Under the hood
- Security: error cards, logs and the model footer hide tokens in URLs, a model id or resume line can't add command-line flags to any engine, and Claude runs no longer read your stored login after each answer.
- Dependency floors raised past recent aiohttp and certifi advisories.

## ⚠️ Heads up
- **Group chat settings need an admin.** In a group, changing settings through `/config`, `/planmode` or `/verbose` now needs a group admin.
- **Webhooks never inherit Claude's `bypassPermissions`.** A webhook run in a bypass chat now runs in `default` mode, so anything that would ask for approval is denied.
- **Scheduled Antigravity runs may be held once.** Untether now checks more of a project's agy config, so a cron or webhook run can pause until someone sends a message in that chat. If you tried Untether's agy plugin on a pre-release, run `untether agy-gate install` again.
- **Webhook servers behind a tunnel or proxy:** set `[triggers.server] exposed = true` so Untether treats the server as public and refuses `auth = "none"` there.
- **Gemini CLI and AMP remain deprecated.** Both still ship and load, but aren't supported. Antigravity replaces Gemini CLI.

## ⬆️ Upgrade
Read [Upgrading to v0.36.1](https://littlebearapps.com/help/untether/update/#upgrading-to-v0361) first. Then upgrade with the tool you installed with:

```sh
uv tool upgrade untether
# or
pipx upgrade untether
```

Restart Untether (or send `/restart` from Telegram) and run `untether doctor` for a quick check.
